select "ws"."id" as "id", "ws"."workflow_id" as "workflowId", ws.snapshot->>'name' as "name", ws.snapshot->>'baseId' as "baseId", (
        SELECT elem
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(ws.snapshot->'nodes') elem
        WHERE elem->>'category' = $1
        LIMIT 1
      ) as "trigger" from "workflow" as "w" inner join "workflow_snapshot" as "ws" on "w"."active_snapshot_id" = "ws"."id" where "w"."is_active" = $2 and "w"."subscribe_resource_id" = $3 and "w"."subscribe_trigger_type" in ($4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) and "w"."deleted_time" is null
